resources.string: You are offline: the chat is deleted here, and from the other phone as soon as you are back online.

If you don\'t type your PIN for %d days, Velo deletes itself from this phone: chats, files, keys and account. You get a notification one day before. The other people keep their chats. It can\'t be undone: keep a backup if you need one.
Open Velo within a day to keep it.
Chats, keys and files, directly between the two phones

Both phones must be on the same Wi-Fi. This phone goes offline during the move and, when the new one has everything, Velo is deleted from here. PIN, panic PIN and appearance are not moved: set them again on the new phone.
On the old phone open Settings, Backup, Move to a new phone. Stay on the same Wi-Fi, then scan the code it shows.
On the new phone tap Receive from another phone and scan this code. Show it to no one else: whoever has it can take your chats.
This is not a valid code.
No Wi-Fi found. Connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi and try again.
Time is up: nothing was moved. Open this page again.
Waiting for the new phone to finish…
Done. Deleting Velo from this phone…
The move did not finish: nothing was deleted and this phone is back online.
The move did not finish: the old phone keeps everything. Clear Velo\'s data here before trying again.
Everything arrived. Velo is being deleted from the old phone. Now set your PIN and panic PIN again in Settings, Security.
Read this code to %s, in person or on a call. If it is the same on both phones, nobody is in between.
The keys of this contact aren\'t here yet. Exchange a message, then open this page again.
Don\'t mark this contact as verified and don\'t share anything sensitive in this chat. If they changed phone, wait for the new key and check again. Otherwise someone may be listening.
The new phone didn\'t answer. Look at it: does it show your chats?
It has everything: delete Velo from here
It didn\'t work: this phone goes back online
